text: Celsius Holdings, Inc. is a US listed company; its 2026 proxy statement's greater-than-5% stockholders table lists William H. Milmoe (6.00%), Deborah DeSantis (7.62%), Dean DeSantis (7.58%), CD Financial, LLC (5.40%), Alani Holdings, LLC (8.74%; Trey Steiger and Max Clemons are its sole members), BlackRock, Inc. (5.64%), Chau Hoi Shuen Solina (8.97%) and AllianceBernstein L.P. (6.27%).
short: The greater-than-5% holders in Celsius Holdings' 2026 proxy are private individuals, a family holding company and asset managers.
